euler_run_endpoint.D_convergence: for every finite J the Euler product D_h(J) converges absolutely, and D_(h,P_y)(J)->D_h(J) along prime-initial supports P_y
euler_run_endpoint.finite_D: D_(h,P)(J)=product_(p in P)(1-|{2hj mod p^2:j in J}|/p^2)
euler_run_endpoint.finite_run_count: on q_P the exact number of bracketed positive runs of length ell is q_P R_(ell,h,P)
euler_run_endpoint.finite_run_density: R_(ell,h,P) is the same four-term expression with D_(h,P)
euler_run_endpoint.run_cutoff: every squarefree step-2h run has length ell<p_0(h)^2
euler_run_endpoint.run_event: R_(ell,h,P) and R_(ell,h) are nonnegative densities of zero at -1, positive at 0,...,ell-1, and zero at ell in step-2h coordinates
euler_run_endpoint.termwise_limit: for each ell, R_(ell,h,P_y)->R_(ell,h), and the cutoff ell<p_0(h)^2 makes the endpoint sum finite

lag_landscape_and_claim_ceiling.boundary_mechanism: for lag h_Y every run boundary is caused by a prime p>Y
lag_landscape_and_claim_ceiling.hY: h_Y=d_Y/2 is a positive integer and 2h_Y=d_Y
lag_landscape_and_claim_ceiling.length_one_witness: choose supported a,b not dividing 2h to force both boundaries by CRT while keeping the center nonzero; avoidance for all remaining primes contributes a positive Euler product, hence R_(1,h)>0
lag_landscape_and_claim_ceiling.run_start_density: sum_(ell>=1)R_(ell,h_Y) is the density of step-d_Y run starts {r squarefree and r-d_Y nonsquarefree}
lag_landscape_and_claim_ceiling.strict_baseline: B_infinity(h)>3/pi^2 for every fixed finite h>=1
lag_landscape_and_claim_ceiling.tail_bound: B_infinity(h_Y)-3/pi^2<=1/2 sum_(p>Y)1/p^2->0 by the boundary union bound

model_and_quantifiers.all_clock_scope: the same terminal value holds for every admissible clock
model_and_quantifiers.capacity: C_h(q)=max_(universally distance-d safe fixed q-phase F)|L_(h,q)(F)|, with the finite maximum taken only after every fixed-table limit
model_and_quantifiers.clock: as X->infinity, 1<=omega(X)<=X and omega(X)->infinity, hence omega(X)>1 eventually
model_and_quantifiers.fixed_data: q and every phase table F_r are fixed before X->infinity
model_and_quantifiers.limit: L_(h,q)(F)=lim_(X->infinity)L_(h,q,X)(F) for every admissible terminal clock
model_and_quantifiers.mobius_extension: mu_0(k)=mu(k) for integer k>=1 and mu_0(k)=0 for k<=0
model_and_quantifiers.order: fix h,q,F; take X->infinity; take the finite maximum over safe F; then take supremum over finite q
model_and_quantifiers.safety: not(F_r(a,b,c)=+1 and F_(r+d)(c,e,f)=+1) for every r and a,b,c,e,f in T

phase_densities.B: B_(p,S)={a_i mod p^2:i in S}, with duplicate residues removed
phase_densities.K: K_j=product_p(1-j/p^2), j=0,1,2,3, are the collision-free j-site constants and K_0=1
phase_densities.Theta: Theta_(h,q,r)(S)=q^-1 product_(p not|q)(1-nu_(p,S)/p^2) product_(p||q)(1-tau_(p,S)(r)/p) product_(p^2|q)1_(r mod p^2 notin B_(p,S))
phase_densities.tau: tau_(p,S)(r)=#{b in B_(p,S):b mod p=r mod p}, counted after mod-p^2 deduplication

projection_relation_reflection.attainment: both signs are attained whenever the optimum is nonzero
projection_relation_reflection.positive_projection: delete +1 outputs at center z!=+1; this weakly increases the mu(n)-weighted score and preserves safety
projection_relation_reflection.reflection_safety: input reflection preserves universal distance-d safety
projection_relation_reflection.source_target: Source(A)={x:exists y (x,y)in A}; Target(A)={y:exists x (x,y)in A}

square_support_and_normalization.centered_square_clock_equality: if p_0(h) is in P then C_h(q_P)=M_h(q_P)=K_1 alpha_h(q_P)/N_h(q_P)
square_support_and_normalization.common_positive_weight: Theta_(h,q_P,r)({C})=K_1/N_h(q_P) at every positive singleton phase
square_support_and_normalization.divisibility_lift: q|Q implies C_h(q)<=C_h(Q) by literal nonminimal-period repetition
square_support_and_normalization.general_square_supported_quantities: if q_P|Q and rad(Q)=rad(q_P), define N_h(Q) as the positive singleton phase count, alpha_h(Q) as the raw step-2h MWIS, M_h(Q)=K_1 alpha_h(Q)/N_h(Q), and delta_Q=K_1/N_h(Q)
square_support_and_normalization.normalization_firewall: on square-support clocks alpha_h(q_P) is raw and unweighted while M_h(q_P) is normalized and weighted; this formula is not asserted for arbitrary q with p||q
square_support_and_normalization.path_charge: a positive step-2h run of length L contributes at most ceil(L/2)delta_Q
square_support_and_normalization.post_p0_fixture: h=6: (alpha,N)=(291,576) at q=900 and (582,1152) at q=1800; ratios agree
square_support_and_normalization.pre_p0_counterexample: h=6: (alpha,N)=(9,24) at q=36 but (24,48) at q=72; ratios 3/8 and 1/2 differ
square_support_and_normalization.raw_MWIS: alpha_h(q_P)=max_(I subset positive phases, I intersect (I+2h)=empty)|I|
square_support_and_normalization.same_support_domain: the base square support must contain p_0(h)^2 before same-support scaling is asserted
square_support_and_normalization.same_support_equality: if q_P|Q and rad(Q)=rad(q_P), with R=Q/q_P, then C_h(Q)=M_h(Q)=M_h(q_P), N_h(Q)=R N_h(q_P), and alpha_h(Q)=R alpha_h(q_P)
square_support_and_normalization.shared_coordinate_marginal: for every adjacent pair of positive center phases r,r+d on square-supported Q and for every t in T, sum_x lambda_(h,Q,r)(x,t)=sum_y lambda_(h,Q,r+d)(t,y)=m_r(t), with sum_t m_r(t)=delta_Q
square_support_and_normalization.square_clock_domain: for a finite prime set P, q_P=product_(p in P)p^2; the quantities N,alpha,M are defined on square-supported clocks, while the capacity equality and endpoint require p_0(h) in P

strict_nonattainment.all_clock_endpoint: sup_(q finite)C_h(q)=B_infinity(h) for each fixed h>=1
strict_nonattainment.arbitrary_q_bridge: for arbitrary finite q choose P containing p_0(h) and every prime divisor of q with B_(h,P)<B_infinity(h), and set Q=lcm(q,q_P); then q|Q, q_P|Q, rad(Q)=rad(q_P), and C_h(q)<=C_h(Q)=M_h(q_P)=B_(h,P)<B_infinity(h)
strict_nonattainment.cofinal_lower_witness: C_h(q_P)=B_(h,P) along prime-initial supports and B_(h,P)->B_infinity(h)
strict_nonattainment.even_excess: E=sum_(even positive runs of length L)L/2
strict_nonattainment.eventual_strictness: for every finite P containing p_0(h), some larger prime-initial P' has B_(h,P')>B_(h,P): enlarge until two supported primes a,b do not divide 2h, use CRT for an exact length-2 run, then adjoin a fresh prime
strict_nonattainment.fresh_prime_domain: adjoin a prime P with P not dividing 2hq after a square base containing p_0(h)^2
strict_nonattainment.odd_deletion_charge: O=sum_(odd positive runs of length L)ceil(L/2)
strict_nonattainment.strict_iff_even: a fresh-prime square lift is strict exactly when the old positive graph has an even run

tropical_capacity.all_q_formula: C_h(q)=sum_(+d cycles gamma) max_(cyclic Y_i subset T) sum_i mathcalK_(r_i)(Y_(i-1),Y_i)
tropical_capacity.cycles: the +d map on Z/qZ has gcd(q,2h) cycles
tropical_capacity.four_state_scope: four-state compression is proved when q does not divide 2h
tropical_capacity.matrix_description: exact tropical trace of 8x8 transition matrices
tropical_capacity.selfloop_criterion: q divides 2h if and only if every +d cycle is a self-loop
tropical_capacity.selfloop_rule: when q divides 2h the theorem retains the full eight-state formula; no four-state reduction is asserted, and h=2,q=4 gives a strict obstruction in general
